visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two golden-brown fried chicken drumsticks are held up close to the camera, showcasing their textured, crispy skin. (2) Hands pull apart a fried chicken thigh, revealing steam and clear juice emerging from the moist white meat inside. (3) A metal whisk is seen stirring a thick, pale yellow batter in a large stainless steel bowl. (4) Tongs are used to coat chicken pieces in batter and then carefully lower them into a deep fryer filled with bubbling oil. (5) Multiple pieces of chicken are shown frying in hot oil, followed by being lifted out with tongs to a metal tray. (6) Seasoning powder is sprinkled over a tray of hot fried chicken pieces. (7) A large bucket featuring a red and white stripe design and a chicken logo is filled with various fried chicken parts. (8) Close-up shots feature individual pieces of chicken: drumsticks, wings, and a large breast cutlet being pulled apart to show internal fibers. (9) Skewers of fried king oyster mushrooms and tempura are held up against a blurry outdoor background. (10) The camera pans to the exterior of a shop named 'Wa Zhai' with a red tile counter and a detailed menu board.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a crisp, high-frequency crunching sound effect immediately followed by upbeat acoustic guitar strumming. A female narrator speaks with high energy and positive valence. (2) As the visuals transition to the bowl, a distinct metallic clinking and sloshing sound of whisking batter is audible. (3) A loud, continuous broadband sizzling sound (deep frying) dominates the mix as the chicken is placed in oil. (4) Rhythmic metallic clicking sounds (tongs) and soft scattering noises are heard as seasoning is applied. (5) Each visual tear of the chicken meat is perfectly synchronized with an exaggerated, crispy 'crunch' SFX. (6) The BGM maintains a steady, happy rhythm throughout, concluding with the narrator providing the shop's address over the final musical fade.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Preparation -> Product Showcase -> Location Info
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is designed to entice viewers with highly sensory 'food porn' visuals and ASMR-style audio of crispy fried chicken to promote a specific local eatery in Gangshan. It uses a fast-paced montage to show variety and quality before providing clear contact and location information for potential customers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the shop '瓦宅炸雞', shows its storefront, menu, and provides the physical address as a call to action.
